subject: Unexpected embed-unit spike — invoice held for review
messages:
From: Aisha Gomez <aisha@stellarcart.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Billing Ops <billing@stellarcart.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Hold on invoice — large embed usage Mar 1-3

Hi Tessa / Ben,

We received the March invoice this morning and Finance has put payment on hold — there
are ~1.1M embed units billed between Mar 1–3 that we don't recognize. Our regular
weekly embedding spend is ~120k, so this looks like a burst or a double-count.

We attached a short sample of our internal telemetry showing the requests that ran from
our test cluster during that window. Can you confirm whether your ingest-side dedupe or
prefix-caching changes (rolled out last week) could have led to duplicate billable
units?

We'd like to get this resolved quickly; can you provide an export of per-request tokens
/ embed-unit attribution and a proposed credit if there's a meter issue? Finance would
like a statement by EOD tomorrow so they can release the payment hold.

Thanks,
Aisha Gomez
Head of Revenue Operations, StellarCart

Attachment: staging-usage-sample_20270301-03.csv (CSV, 48KB)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gomez <aisha@stellarcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hold on invoice — large embed usage Mar 1-3

Hi Aisha — thanks for the heads up and for the sample. I'm looking into this now.

Quick notes so you know what we'll do:
- I'm pulling per-request attribution logs for Mar 1–3 (tokenized and per-prefix).
- We'll check our deploy notes — we did a small KV-cache change on Mar 2 that should
  reduce duplicate generation, not increase it, but we'll verify whether any backfill
  or replay path accidentally re-ingested requests.
- Monica from Billing will validate the invoice math and estimate an interim credit
  if we identify a metering issue.

Can you confirm the Hub ID / environment the CSV came from (staging vs prod)? The
sample has a prefix that looks like your staging namespace; if those calls were run
against your staging key but attributed to prod, that could explain the delta.

I'll follow up with the export and a proposed credit by tomorrow EOD. Apologies for
the disruption — we'll prioritize this.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0123

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Hold on invoice — large embed usage Mar 1-3

Ben / Monica — forwarding Aisha's note and their sample. Key asks: export of per-request
attribution and a proposed credit by EOD tomorrow.

Quick triage from my side (I pulled logs for Mar 1–3):
- There are ~1.09M embed units under namespace sc_prod_main, but I also see a replay job
  from our ingest pipeline that reprocessed a staging batch on Mar 2 (job id: rp-44211).
- The replay shows 920k requests re-ingested without tenant namespace stripping; some
  requests retained the staging namespace prefix (sc_staging_) while others mapped to
  sc_prod_main due to a join step. That suggests attribution could have flipped.

Monica: can you run the invoice math on the attached per-request export I just pulled
(and see file names below)? If the replayer caused double attribution we should propose
an interim credit equal to the duplicated embed units (estimate attached).

Attachments included for internal review: usage_export_84721_20270301-03.csv (1.7MB)
and a quick pivot I ran: embed_dup_estimate_84721.xlsx (50KB) — both placed in the
shared drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-usage-exports

Let me know if you need me to loop infra (they own the replay job). If we confirm a
platform-side replay mistake we'll propose a full credit and an operational note.

Thanks,
Tessa

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gomez <aisha@stellarcart.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>,
     Billing Ops <billing@stellarcart.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 16:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Hold on invoice — large embed usage Mar 1-3

Hi Aisha — thanks again for the sample and patience while we investigated. Summary and
next steps below.

What happened
- On Mar 2 our nightly reprocessor (rp-44211) replayed a staging batch into the
  aggregation pipeline. Due to a mapping bug in the namespace normalization step,
  ~960k embed requests from your staging key were attributed to sc_prod_main. Those
  requests should not have counted toward your live production usage.

What we did
- We removed the duplicated requests from your billed usage and prepared an adjusted
  invoice draft (attached). Monica: we applied a credit for 960,412 embed units.
- We also fixed the normalization routine — patch rolled to prod at 09:30 UTC on
  Mar 10; we've added an assertion and a replay-safety gate to prevent future flips.

What you get now
- Attached: invoice_84721_Mar01-03_draft.pdf (adjusted total and line-item credit)
- Attached: staging-usage-sample_20270301-03.csv (the sample you sent)
- A provisional credit note will appear on your March statement; Finance can release
  the payment hold once you confirm receipt.

Next steps / ask
- Please confirm receipt and whether StellarCart would like the credit applied as a
  balance or an immediate refund.
- If you'd like, we can schedule a 30-min postmortem with Infra and Billing this
  week to walk through the replay bug and the mitigation.

Apologies again for the disruption — we own this and will tighten the safety gates.

Best regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.inference

Attachments: invoice_84721_Mar01-03_draft.pdf (PDF, 72KB); staging-usage-sample_20270301-03.csv (CSV, 48KB)
